title: 知覚・認知心理学A
subtitle: Psychology of Perception and Cognition A
educationalGoal: The basis of human behavior is information processing. This course focuses on sense perception (the mental process of sensory input) and cognition (the mental process of information processing). The neural basis and neural disorder of sense perception and cognition will also be introduced.
advice: A large part of the course consists of lectures. However, some demonstrations and practice exercises will also be conducted.
requiredKnowledge: Students are recommended to review the “Elements of Psychology” and “Practice of Elementary Psychological Experiments” courses.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain human cognitive function scientifically.
Ability to understand human cognitive processes and be able to explain them.
Ability to understand the neural basis of sense perception and cognition and be able to explain it.
Ability to understand disorders in sense perception and cognition and be able to explain them.
Ability to understand studies related to sense perception and cognition.

achievementLevels.standard: Realize the basic function of sense perception and cognition and explain the human mental process.
